author: Pubity
text:
A man named Nigel Richards has become so good at Scrabble that he's the undisputed Scrabble GOAT.

He won 5 English World Championships, got bored, and won Worlds in French and Spanish without learning to speak either language.

He's earned upwards of $200k in prize money.
